verses.1: So then, be imitators of God, as beloved children,
verses.2: and walk in love, just as Christ also loved us and gave himself up for us, a sacrifice and offering to God as a pleasing aroma.
verses.3: But all kinds of immorality and uncleanness or greed must not even be named among you, for they are fitting for holy ones,
verses.4: nor any indecency or foolish speech or crude humor, which are not fitting, but rather thankfulness.
verses.5: For you must know this, understanding that every immoral person or unclean one or avaricious one, who is an idolater, does not inherit the kingdom of Christ and God.
verses.6: Let no one deceive you with empty words, for because of these things the wrath of God comes upon the children of disobedience.
verses.7: Therefore do not become partakers with them;
verses.8: for you were once darkness, but now you are light in the Lord. Walk as children of light,
verses.9: for the fruit of the light is in every kind of goodness and righteousness and truth,
verses.10: discerning what is pleasing to the Lord;
verses.11: and do not take part in the fruitless works of darkness, but rather even expose them,
verses.12: for what is done in secret among them is shameful to speak of;
verses.13: but when everything is exposed by the light, it becomes visible,
verses.14: for everything that becomes visible is light. Therefore it is said, "Wake up, you who are sleeping, and arise from the dead, and Christ will shine on you."
verses.15: So be careful how you walk, not as unwise but as wise,
verses.16: redeeming the time, for the days are evil.
verses.17: Therefore do not be foolish, but understand what is the will of the Lord,
verses.18: and do not get drunk on wine, which leads to debauchery, but be filled with the Spirit,
verses.19: speaking to yourselves with psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing and making music in your hearts to the Lord,
verses.20: always giving thanks for everything in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ to God the Father,
verses.21: submitting to one another in the fear of Christ.
verses.22: Wives to your own husbands, as to the Lord,
verses.23: for the husband is the head of the wife, just as Christ is the head of the church, himself the savior of the body.
verses.24: But as the church is subject to Christ, so also the wives to their husbands in everything.
verses.25: Husbands, love your wives, just as Christ also loved the church and gave himself up for her,
verses.26: to sanctify her, having cleansed her by the washing of water with the word,
verses.27: to present her to himself glorious, the church, having no spot or wrinkle or anything like that, but that she may be holy and blameless.
verses.28: So husbands must also love their own wives as their own bodies. The one who loves his wife loves himself,
verses.29: for no one has ever hated his own body, but he nourishes and cherishes it, just as Christ also does the church,
verses.30: for we are members of his body.
verses.31: For this reason a man will leave his father and mother and will cling to his wife, and the two will become one flesh.
verses.32: This is a great mystery, but I speak in reference to Christ and the church.
verses.33: Nevertheless, each of you, as individuals, must love your own wife as yourself, and the wife must fear her husband.

notes:
Notes
- v. 21: "submit to one another in the fear of Christ" — the Greek uses "φόβῳ" (fear), which can mean reverence or awe rather than fear in the sense of terror.
- v. 28: "the one who loves his wife loves himself" — the Greek uses a reflexive pronoun ("ἑαυτόν"), which is translated as "himself" to avoid confusion with the object of love.
